WRHA RESOURCE ASSISTANT

Gia

Source-grounded answers from the four loaded manuals.

Hi, I’m Gia.

I can search the STI Handbook 2026, PrEP Handbook 2023, Tuberculosis Manual and PMTCT manual. I keep short-term topic context, so after asking “syphilis,” you can ask “dose?”, “pregnant?” or “partner?”.

Clinical guidance is displayed only when supported by the loaded manuals. Gia does not send your clinical questions to an external AI service.
Local, source-grounded quick reference · No clinical-query analytics
